one_liner: Web scraping and data extraction service that turns websites into clean, structured data for AI systems.

auth.notes: Supports API keys sent as Bearer tokens (fc-* prefix) and OAuth2 (fco_* and fcr_* tokens). MCP OAuth also available for browser-based authentication.

evidence.snippet: There are four ways to authenticate with Firecrawl.
send it on every request as Authorization: Bearer fc-YOUR-API-KEY
OAuth for apps Send the user through Firecrawl’s OAuth flow with resource=https://api.firecrawl.dev/

access.notes: Free tier with 1,000 credits/month, no credit card required. Keyless endpoints available with rate limits. No approval, sales contact, or admin intervention needed.

evidence.snippet: Free tier 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
Create a free account for direct API access and higher limits
A few REST endpoints also work with no credential at all, so you can try Firecrawl before you have a key.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Plan-dependent rate limits documented per endpoint: /scrape, /map, /search at 10/min (free), /crawl and /agent limits vary by plan. /interact at 2/min (free). 429 responses when exceeded.

evidence.snippet: Real-time notifications for your Firecrawl operations
Rate limit, /scrape, /map and /search Your team gets this many requests a minute for each endpoint. 10 / min
Hosted MCP with an API key Point your MCP client at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve API credentials, broad REST API with webhooks, official MCP server, and clear documentation enable immediate toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Search finds relevant information on the web. Scrape turns websites into clean, structured, AI-usable data.
